verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs describe a draft, review and approval flow in which feature revisions can be made to require approval before publishing. Approval workflows are listed as a higher-tier plan feature, and API-driven risky changes can be held until a person confirms them. Coverage is still partial: the evidence never shows approvals scoped specifically to production environments, and the capability is plan-gated. missing for 10: documented per-environment (production-only) approval enforcement, detail on reviewer/approver configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval flow.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Draft feature revisions, request review, resolve merge conflicts, and require approval before publishing.
Continue adding changes to the draft, and when you're ready, publish them all at once with an optional commit message.
Require confirmation holds risky changes until a person confirms them in GrowthBook.
